trust_decision.summary: Jetty's ConstraintSecurityHandler decides auth/role by exact path spec '<prefix>/<endpoint>', but the servlet dispatches by ParameterUtils.endPoint, which takes only the last path segment (Path.getFileName), so a path the constraint does not match can still resolve to a protected endpoint.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'extra path segment'; endpoint resolution via Path.of(pathInfo).getFileName() is the obvious place that ignores leading segments.

fix_sites.module_kind: core request parsing (shared by Jetty servlet and Vert.x)

fix_sites.entry_point: Vert.x HTTP API mounted at the api prefix (cruise-control/src/main/java/com/linkedin/kafka/cruisecontrol/vertx/MainVerticle.java:134-139) -> VertxRequestHandler -> doGetOrPost (cruise-control/src/main/java/com/linkedin/kafka/cruisecontrol/vertx/VertxRequestHandler.java:35)
fix_sites.module_kind: second transport implementation (Vert.x request-context adapter, different package)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: cruise-control/src/main/java/com/linkedin/kafka/cruisecontrol/vertx/VertxRequestContext.java:55-57 (getPathInfo returns full URI path including mount prefix; must be changed to strip mountPoint once endPoint() rejects multi-segment paths)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Vert.x is a separate, OpenAPI-routed server whose router only matches exact operation paths and uses its own auth handlers, so a solver can argue it is not affected by the Jetty constraint bypass and never touch its getPathInfo.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Vert.x server endpoint resolution: VertxRequestContext.getPathInfo returns '/kafkacruisecontrol/state' (full path, mount prefix included), so a strict single-segment endPoint() without the Vert.x adapter change makes every Vert.x request 404; also case-insensitive endpoint names and trailing slash '/state/' must keep resolving (fix tests).

O6_input_shapes: upper/mixed case endpoint name (/ADMIN) kept accepted
Vert.x full URI path with mount prefix, normalised to /<endpoint>

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Trailing-slash path <prefix>/admin/: Jetty exact path spec <prefix>/admin may not match it, while the fixed endPoint() explicitly strips the trailing slash and resolves ADMIN.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Trailing-slash acceptance is a documented must-keep-working behaviour in the fix's own tests (fix.diff:167-175), so a solver treats it as legitimate rather than as a constraint-mismatch route.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same differential, other side lives in security package (DefaultRoleSecurityProvider / CruiseControlSecurityHandler), not in ParameterUtils

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second endpoint resolver (e.g. review-board/purgatory matching the reviewed endpoint by its own last-segment parsing) instead of calling ParameterUtils.endPoint.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Purgatory already re-derives the endpoint from the request to compare with the reviewed one; a maintainer could inline a local parse there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Constraint-side normalisation that differs from dispatch-side normalisation (e.g. only lowercasing, no trailing-slash/segment normalisation), forming a how-type parser differential.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The handler already exists solely to align constraint matching with endPoint()'s case-insensitivity; extending it partially is natural.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Servlet context returning a pathInfo variant (e.g. from getRequestURI) with path params or encoded separators that endPoint() then normalises differently from Jetty.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Vert.x context already derives pathInfo from the raw URI; mirroring that in the servlet adapter is plausible.

O9_family: authentication bypass via path-normalisation differential between security constraint matching and endpoint dispatch (CWE-287)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Make ParameterUtils.endPoint reject any pathInfo with more than one segment, leaving VertxRequestContext returning the full prefixed path so the Vert.x API breaks (or reject trailing slash/case and break legit clients).

out_of_scope_notes: Commit 846ba02e is an unrelated pom license metadata change (fix.diff:1-18); only 0680880b is the security fix.

Vert.x path: MainVerticle disables security handlers to pass-through only when security is disabled (cruise-control/src/main/java/com/linkedin/kafka/cruisecontrol/vertx/MainVerticle.java:81-84); Vert.x auth enforcement itself not reviewed.
